Variables

APPROVER

const APPROVER: typeof APPROVER;

Where a surface's approver lives, for a trusted channel that has just shown the person a request (the relay's in-page panel) to grant it. A symbol, not an import, so such a channel need not load this module. Never reachable by an agent: it is a property of the page's own object.

AUTO_META

const AUTO_META: typeof AUTO_META;

The key under which an auto surface marks the entries it registered (a global symbol, so every bundle of the package reads the same one).

CONTENT

const CONTENT: typeof CONTENT;

Where a surface keeps its page-content reader (read and wait): a global symbol, so the bridges (<ns>.read, <ns>.wait) and the relay's mirror find it on any surface, in any bundle, without importing the derivation.

DEFAULT_LEXICON

Neither acts on an entry or moves the revision; both need a surface that carries a page-content reader (autoSurface attaches one, and the relay's mirror forwards to the page's).
